name: dense_test
description: Technical test: 60 fps dense per-frame samples on several roles (mocap-like data)

reference_pose.pose: T-pose: torso, neck and head upright, arms horizontal to the sides, palms down, legs straight down, feet forward
reference_pose.axes: engine axes: metres, +Y up, the character faces +Z, the character's left is +X
reference_pose.rules: Per role: 'parent' is the semantic parent role (clip rotations are local to it); the rest direction runs from the role's head to the head of 'end' (or along 'end_dir'; 'continue': the direction from the parent role's head to this head; 'end_fallback_dir_from_parent': if 'end' is missing, the parent's direction); the twist reference is 'twist_hint' (or the vector from the second 'twist_from' head to the first) made perpendicular to the direction. 'ref_dir' / 'ref_twist' are the neutral reference pose. '.L' entries are mirrored to '.R' (x -> -x). Eyes are not clip roles (gaze belongs to look).
